flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4103 then book a free first visit for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown and store the reference as {{ref}}.

remark: click: Clicking Dismiss cookie notice button
click: Clicking the Book a free visit button
wait: queued plan (4 steps): type "Your name"; type "Email address"; type "Visit date"
click: Clicking the 12pm arrival time option
click: Clicking the I accept the climbing waiver checkbox
click: Clicking Confirm my free visit button
analyze: the booking reference code is stored as {{ref}}
assert: a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown

summary:
Booked a free first visit for Sam Rivera using sam@example.com for November 2, 2026 at noon.
Accepted the waiver.
The booking was confirmed and a reference code was provided: PL-4821.
one_liner: booked a free first visit on localhost
